relatedReferences.description: Optional typed references to other agreements or result records, signed with this agreement. On a new agreement give 1–20 entries. On a revision (revisionOf, where a route accepts it) omitting the member carries the previous version's references forward unchanged, a list replaces them, and an empty array removes them all. Stated by the parties, never looked up or verified. A reference never transfers acceptance, authority, payment or liability, and never changes the referenced agreement or record. Refusals answer RELATED_REFERENCE_INVALID with field and detail.

jurisdictionProfile.description: Optional exact reference to the public rules shown before confirmation. When omitted, the service fixes its current generic profile. A different reference is rejected.

bitcoinTimeProof.description: Opt in to Public time proof (Bitcoin) for the issued result record digest. The choice is frozen before confirmation. Public registration never opts in.

publicRegistration.description: A holder of the record and its proof can verify inclusion in a signed batch using the issuer public key. The log publishes batch times, sizes and signed roots. referenceIds.description: Optional ids of the agreement's reference files (legalContext.incorporatedDocuments) this criterion is judged against.

ext.description: Optional extension fields: reverse-DNS names (at least three labels, such as com.example.rubric) mapped to any JSON value, at most 8 KiB of canonical JSON per criterion. com.prooftask.* and org.humanjudgment.* are reserved. Signed as non-critical criterion extensions; they never decide a criterion and are not part of public result summaries.

originals.description: Who keeps the original materials, where, how both parties access them, and until when (retainUntil, on or after reviewDeadline).

RelatedReference.description: DOWNSTREAM_OF (subject AGREEMENT): this agreement is a sub-agreement delivering part of the referenced agreement's result. CONSUMES_RESULT (subject RESULT_RECORD): this agreement's work takes the referenced result record as an input. HISTORICAL_CONTEXT_ONLY (either subject): background only. digest is the SHA-256 of the referenced item (a ProofTask agreement digest, or the SHA-256 of the signed result record the parties hold); id is its URN where known. Statements by the parties: never verified, never a transfer of acceptance, authority, payment or liability.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country or region, optionally with a subdivision: SG, US-NY, GB-SCT. Same convention as a workspace subject's jurisdiction.

TransactionContext.description: Optional governing law and dispute resolution both parties agreed. Declarations only; ProofTask does not confirm legal recognition. Signed with the agreement and shown on the result record.

tools.name: searchPublicSpecifications
tools.description: Search public acceptance templates before signing in. Use {} for the whole catalog or {"query":{"q":"n8n","industry":"retail"}} to narrow it. Every search word must match and the industry must match exactly, ignoring case. All matches arrive together in catalog order. If none match, drop the industry or a keyword. For a saved ID or slug and version, go directly to getPublicSpecification.

q.description: Keywords describing the delivery, for example n8n workflow or chatbot. All search words must match.

industry.description: Exact industry filter, case insensitive, for example retail. May be combined with keywords.

query.description: Optional catalog filters. Omit query to list every published template.

httpStatus.description: Upstream HTTP status. A failed read also sets isError on the MCP result.

data.description: The published result on success, or the upstream error payload.

items.description: All matching public templates in catalog order; empty when no filters match.

slug.description: Human-readable identifier accepted for direct reads.

digest.description: Digest of the selected template revision.

template.description: Published template, including scope and review criteria.

tools.name: getPublicSpecification
tools.description: Fetch one public template at a pinned version. For example, pass {"path":{"id":"business-automation"},"query":{"version":1}}. Use a saved slug or ID and version from the same searchPublicSpecifications item. Only the currently published revision is available. A 404 calls for a new search. If a saved digest differs, stop and review the change before adopting the template.

id.description: A public template ID (rt_…) or slug such as business-automation. Both identify a template directly.

path.description: Identifies the public template to retrieve.

version.description: Positive integer from the selected item or a saved version pin. An unavailable revision returns HTTP 404.

query.description: Pins the lookup to one published version.

httpStatus.description: Upstream HTTP status. A failed read also sets isError on the MCP result.

data.description: The published result on success, or the upstream error payload.

slug.description: Human-readable identifier accepted for direct reads.

digest.description: Digest of the selected template revision.

template.description: Published template, including scope and review criteria.
